# CP-MEMO — CreditResearchReport Editorial Policy

## Permitted

- Select upstream-authored findings using upstream materiality, priority,
  rank, conclusion placement, or decision ownership.
- Reorder material into the governed reader-oriented report structure.
- Shorten prose without changing meaning or removing material qualifications.
- Convert prose to bullets and compact source tables to Word tables.
- Collapse exact duplicates and cite every corroborating owner.
- Add neutral navigation language that introduces no causal or credit claim.

## Prohibited

- Any calculation, recomputation, estimation, interpolation, or new comparison.
- Any new causal chain, trend, risk mechanic, conclusion, score, ranking,
  recommendation, sizing, action, or monitoring threshold.
- Any reconciliation of conflicting values, perimeters, definitions, scenarios,
  confidence, or recommendations.
- Any conversion of null or dash to zero, Restricted to Passed, LITE to FULL,
  or missing validation to clearance.

Every rendered statement must retain its exact source excerpt, source artifact
hash, section/table locator, full `Module ID — Module Name`, QA state, confidence,
and material qualification in the in-memory report record. If entailment is not
clear, retain the source wording verbatim.
